stem: Oldbury Systems wants to confirm, after an EC2 instance is created, that it actually received a public DNS hostname, using the instance's own final attributes. Which mechanism fits, on Terraform 1.2 or later?

choices.text: a variable `validation` block referencing the resource's `public_dns` attribute
a `check` block that only runs during `terraform plan`, never during `apply`

rationale: A postcondition checks the object's actual, final attributes after Terraform creates it, referenced through self -- exactly this scenario, and it needs Terraform 1.2 or later, matching the stated version. A precondition instead runs before the resource is created, so self.public_dns wouldn't yet reflect a real created instance. A variable validation block can only see the variable it's attached to, not a resource's own computed attributes. A check block runs at both plan and apply, not plan only, so that description is wrong regardless of anything else.
